svg.title: Pigment Wall
svg.desc: The same pixel-art fox shown four times: entirely grey at 0 percent of the day's target, partly coloured at 45 percent, fully coloured at 100 percent, and bleached white at 260 percent.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: It colours in as you burn tokens.
